quotes.text: Our family of eight booked a private tour from Toronto to Niagara Falls and had a fantastic time. Same guide as our Toronto private tour the day before — couldn't recommend more.
Loved this tour and everything our guide shared — funny, friendly, and clearly passionate about the region. We covered the Falls and then Niagara-on-the-Lake; a great day out.
Smaller group than I expected — only six of us in a comfortable SUV. The pace felt relaxed, not rushed. Highly recommend if you want the views without the coach-tour feel.
Huge thanks to our guide for making my son's first trip to Canada one we'll remember for a long time. Every stop was well-paced and the boat cruise was the highlight.
The Falls plus Whirlpool Rapids plus the Floral Clock filled an exceptional day. Our guide read the group well — when we wanted more time at a stop, he extended it.
Solid value for a half-day private tour. We did a quick run with two kids and were back in Toronto in time for dinner. Driver was patient with stroller logistics.
